title: Hexxt Huntmaster
summary: Keep the group recovered through the Huntmaster's late-fight arrow volleys.
overview: Keep the group recovered through the Huntmaster's late-fight arrow volleys.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Expect unpredictable bursts below 45% and maintain group healing.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The Huntmaster takes reduced archery damage from the start.
At 45% health, a twenty-second timer begins checking for a volley of random-target arrows.
Healing back through 45% or leaving combat stops that timer.

notes: Approval E409. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The volley handler only covers hate-list sizes one through six; behavior above six targets needs verification.
Resolve the exact NPC template IDs from the zone database before enabling NPC-page links.
